placeholders.<scratch>: the run's temporary directory (an absolute path); the path after it is written with / whatever the platform's separator

read: cases: config_toml / managed_toml (null: no file; *_hex: the bytes, when they are not UTF-8) -> check and show, each the exit code and the text the CLI printed (one JSON document, where a non-finite float prints bare as NaN or Infinity), or raised: the exception that escaped the command; each command runs with the loader's one-shot notices cleared, as a CLI process of its own would; and audit_config_findings, the config findings of `security audit` (posture._settings over the config the audit loads). Check exits 0 (nothing above a note), 1 (an error), 2 (warnings only). pure_paths: [text, str(PurePosixPath(text)), str(PureWindowsPath(text)) with each backslash written as /].
setup: Every location variable points into <scratch> (_sandbox.world): BETTERMEMORY_DIR=<scratch>/mem, BETTERMEMORY_KEYS_DIR=<scratch>/keys, BETTERMEMORY_STATE_DIR=<scratch>/state, HOME=<scratch>/home. The user's config file is <scratch>/user/config.toml (config.default_config_path answers it) and the managed file <scratch>/managed/managed.toml (managed.managed_config_path answers it); a case that has no text for one has no such file. The CLI runs in process (cli.main with argv set).
